## Keyboard Clicker 2.2.0

This release introduces Automation Studio, a visual graph-based workflow editor for the Rust desktop application. The original Python application and the Classic linear sequence editor remain available.

### Highlights

- Arrange connected workflow nodes on a free-positioning canvas and edit their properties in the inspector.
- Build mouse click/move, keyboard, text, wait, condition, variable, and bounded repeat workflows.
- Import and export validated workflow JSON, including supported Autoflow Designer 1.0 action graphs.
- Save Studio drafts automatically; validate graphs before enabling Start.
- Preserve up to 256 legacy actions plus the graph's terminal node during migration. Disabled Classic actions are not activated by migration.
- Continue using the Classic editor as a separate workflow; the UI makes the separation explicit.
- English, German, and Russian strings are included.

### Platforms and safety

The release workflow builds a portable x64 Windows executable and ZIP, plus an x86_64 Linux tarball. SHA-256 sidecars accompany the release assets. Imported workflow files remain data-only; arbitrary scripts and shell commands are not executed. Linux input simulation currently uses X11, and Wayland behavior depends on the compositor.
